$comment: Pre-registered retrieval thresholds (docs/plan-1.0.md section 8, WP0, WP1, WP3a). `target` values come from the plan and were written before any tuning; they are never adjusted to pass. `baseline` is the shipped 0.9.1 search (src/search.js, AND semantics) measured by `npm run eval:search` on 2026-10-24 with --split all, minus the 95% bootstrap half-width per metric (1,000 samples, seed 20261024); test/retrieval-eval.test.js asserts it as a regression floor. zeroResultRateMax is measured plus the half-width.

alpinaria.gate: full set (203 queries, above the 150 threshold): pre-registered targets on the full set, and a held-out drop larger than the bootstrap CI blocks a merge (section 8); tune only on split dev

target.source: WP1 acceptance, measured with the shipped default languages: auto
target.sectionAnchorHitRateSource: WP3a acceptance on labelled dev queries via get_context

atlas.gate: full set (94 queries, below the 150 threshold): pre-registered target on the full set with bootstrap CI; dev/heldout reported, not gated

target.sectionAnchorHitRateSource: WP3a acceptance on labelled dev queries via get_context
